messages_orig.content: Hey Dr Redwood. 35yo female with an occasional pressing sensation behind her left eye. Labs are unremarkable, no other major complaints. Sometimes it fades fast if she rests, but other times it intensifies into a dull ache. I’m not sure if this is something that needs an urgent workup or if it might just be normal eye strain. Thinking about having her keep track of when it happens and see if that helps. Thoughts on if that’s a good plan or if there’s something else you’d suggest.
